At every key point in your growth, you will receive guidance from industry experts and HR specialists, ensuring that every step you take at Ctrip is solid and meaningful. A hug after completing a challenging project, a smile after making a "basic mistake," a lunch between company executives and ordinary employees—these happen every day at Ctrip. "Passion and innocence" are in the DNA of Ctrip employees, and our "campus-style" corporate culture keeps them young at heart. Active in various cultural activities, Ctrip employees spread joy and happiness to everyone around them. Your contributions will be rewarded with more than just a salary.
